source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 28 aprilie — «Sfinții Mucenici Maxim, Cvintilian și Dadas din Ozovia»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 13ης Απριλίου — «Άγιοι Κυντιλλιανός, Μάξιμος και Δάδας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 13 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and gives the three no years: it sets them only in the reigns of «Μαξιμιανού (285 - 305 μ.Χ.) και Διοκλητιανού (284 - 305 μ.Χ.)» and under «τῶν ὑπάτων Γαβιβίου και Ταρκυΐνου», so no `dates` were taken. **The Greek keeps the three a fortnight before the Romanian**, which prints them on 28 aprilie; both pages are the same company — the three readers of the Church from Ozovia, beheaded together — and the Greek adds their office, the consuls' names, and the resting place of the relics at Constantinople, in the church of the Most Holy Mother of God «ἐν τοὶς Βιγλεντίου», where their synaxis was kept. The page prints no hymn.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (20 September 2026).

hymns.text: Mucenicii Tăi, Doamne, întru nevoinţele lor, cununile nesctricăciunii au dobândit de la Tine, Dumnezeul nostru. Că având tăria Ta, pe chinuitori au învins; zdrobit-au şi ale demonilor neputincioase îndrăzniri. Pentru rugăciunile lor, mântuieşte sufletele noastre, Hristoase Dumnezeule.

source.text: doxologia.ro, «Troparul Sfinților Mucenici Maxim, Cvintilian și Dadas din Ozovia», Glasul 4

english.text: Thy martyrs, O Lord, in their striving won from Thee, our God, the crowns of incorruption; for having Thy strength, they overthrew their tormentors and shattered the feeble daring of the demons. By their prayers, O Christ God, save our souls.
